policies.title: Iraqi citizenship is outside foreign visitor-visa scope
policies.summary: An Iraqi ordinary passport belongs to an Iraqi citizen, whereas the federal Residence Law defines the visitor-visa regime for foreigners.
conditions: Does not decide a dual national’s document choice, residence, departure, security screening, consular treatment, or treatment when travelling on a foreign passport.

Article 1(Third)(h) separately excludes Iraqis and their children who hold foreign passports; that individual origin/document exception is not converted into a nationality-wide classification for every foreign passport code.

The federal law separately carves out heads of state, diplomatic and consular personnel, crew, authorized ship/plane/train passengers, treaty beneficiaries, minors on relatives’ passports, and neighboring-border residents. Those special-document, route, treaty, and residence facts are outside this ordinary-passport policy.
